entries.bfac1adde35c4538: Because the real estate-secured loan business is susceptible to real estate market conditions, it considers it important to contain credit losses arising from declines in collateral values. Its basic policy is to steadily continue growing by maintaining low-cost management that limits loan losses in both boom and downturn periods. Over the medium to long term, centered on the real estate-secured loan business, it intends to conduct the adjacent credit guarantee and real estate leasing businesses to diversify its earnings base.
entries.ca878a7c9659f120: Operating revenue was ¥8,779 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. By product and service, real estate-secured loans were ¥8,435 million and real estate leasing was ¥344 million.
